title: valance.json
description: The project: what the application is called. Settings for a target are in valance.<target>.json (valance.web.json for the web).

version.description: The version of this file's format.

name.description: The application's name: the site's title in navigation and in every page's <title>.

title.description: How a document's title is written: "{page}" is the page's title and "{site}" the name above. Must contain "{page}". A page whose title is the site's name is that name alone.
